def player_pos(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            c=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]; r=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(r),max(r),min(c),max(c))
    return None
def cellgrid(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    colb=[13,19,25,31,37,43,49,54]
    rowb=[1,7,13,19,25,31,37,43,49,55,61,63]
    g=[]
    for ri in range(len(rowb)-1):
        row=''
        for ci in range(len(colb)-1):
            cnt=0; tot=0
            for r in range(rowb[ri],rowb[ri+1]):
                for c in range(colb[ci],colb[ci+1]):
                    tot+=1
                    if a[r][c]=='S': cnt+=1
            row += '#' if cnt>tot*0.5 else ('.' if cnt==0 else 'o')
        g.append(row)
    return g
for idx in [10,11,12]:
    pl=player_pos(history[idx].frame)
    print('idx',idx,'pc',pl[2])
    for row in cellgrid(history[idx].frame): print(' ',row)
